Looking at the coordinates, the route goes from 40.458, -79.929 to 40.444, -79.993, which suggests the starting point is already positioned near the Japanese food market at 40.45760, -79.92933.

The destination 40.444, -79.993 should be 401 Shady Ave, but I need to reverse the directions so I'm walking from 401 Shady Ave to the market. More importantly, I should switch the routing engine from Car to Foot (OSRM) to get proper walking directions instead of driving directions.
